name: Valaris, First of the Wood
summary: The eldest of the Wandering Wood: she calls the fallen from the Requiem and blesses those who wake.

face.name: Valaris, First of the Wood

firstCall.text: Put an Auros Entity with Flux cost 3 or less from your Requiem Zone onto your Front.

wakingBoon.text: The first time each of your turns another Auros Entity you control is untapped by an effect, that Entity gets +1 Power until end of turn.

face.flavor: She was there before the wood. The wood grew around her silence.
